commands.command:
set -eu
ns=antrieb-fwprobe
hostif=fwprobe-host
peerif=fwprobe-peer
p8080=
p8081=
cleanup() {
  if [ -n "$p8080" ]; then kill "$p8080" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
  if [ -n "$p8081" ]; then kill "$p8081" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
  firewall-cmd --zone=public --remove-interface="$hostif" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  ip netns del "$ns" 2>/dev/null || true
  ip link del "$hostif" 2>/dev/null || true
  rm -f /tmp/fwprobe-8080.log /tmp/fwprobe-8081.log
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
ip netns add "$ns"
ip link add "$hostif" type veth peer name "$peerif"
ip link set "$peerif" netns "$ns"
ip addr add 192.0.2.1/30 dev "$hostif"
ip link set "$hostif" up
ip netns exec "$ns" ip addr add 192.0.2.2/30 dev "$peerif"
ip netns exec "$ns" ip link set lo up
ip netns exec "$ns" ip link set "$peerif" up
firewall-cmd --zone=public --add-interface="$hostif" >/dev/null
python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 192.0.2.1 >/tmp/fwprobe-8080.log 2>&1 & p8080=$!
python3 -m http.server 8081 --bind 192.0.2.1 >/tmp/fwprobe-8081.log 2>&1 & p8081=$!
sleep 1
kill -0 "$p8080"
kill -0 "$p8081"
printf '%s\n' '--- temporary listeners for packet probes ---'
ss -lntp | awk '$4 ~ /:8080$/ || $4 ~ /:8081$/ {print}'
if ip netns exec "$ns" timeout 3 bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/192.0.2.1/22'; then printf '%s\n' 'probe_ssh=ACCEPTED'; else printf '%s\n' 'probe_ssh=FAILED'; exit 1; fi
if ip netns exec "$ns" timeout 3 bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/192.0.2.1/8080'; then printf '%s\n' 'probe_tcp_8080=ACCEPTED'; else printf '%s\n' 'probe_tcp_8080=FAILED'; exit 1; fi
if ip netns exec "$ns" timeout 3 bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/192.0.2.1/8081' 2>/tmp/fwprobe-reject.err; then printf '%s\n' 'probe_tcp_8081=UNEXPECTEDLY_ACCEPTED'; exit 1; else printf '%s\n' 'probe_tcp_8081=REJECTED'; sed -n '1,3p' /tmp/fwprobe-reject.err; fi
rm -f /tmp/fwprobe-reject.err
printf '%s\n' 'inbound_probe_assertions=PASS'

		iifname "enp1s0" jump filter_IN_policy_allow-host-ipv6
		iifname "enp1s0" jump filter_IN_public
		iifname "enp1s0" reject with icmpx admin-prohibited
		jump filter_IN_policy_allow-host-ipv6
		jump filter_IN_public
		reject with icmpx admin-prohibited
	}
}

commands.command:
set -eu
ns=antrieb-fwprobe
hostif=fwprobe-host
peerif=fwprobe-peer
p8080=
p8081=
cleanup() {
  if [ -n "$p8080" ]; then kill "$p8080" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
  if [ -n "$p8081" ]; then kill "$p8081" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
  firewall-cmd --zone=public --remove-interface="$hostif" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  ip netns del "$ns" 2>/dev/null || true
  ip link del "$hostif" 2>/dev/null || true
  rm -f /tmp/fwprobe-8080.log /tmp/fwprobe-8081.log /tmp/fwprobe-reject.err
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
ip netns add "$ns"
ip link add "$hostif" type veth peer name "$peerif"
ip link set "$peerif" netns "$ns"
ip addr add 192.0.2.1/30 dev "$hostif"
ip link set "$hostif" up
ip netns exec "$ns" ip addr add 192.0.2.2/30 dev "$peerif"
ip netns exec "$ns" ip link set lo up
ip netns exec "$ns" ip link set "$peerif" up
firewall-cmd --zone=public --add-interface="$hostif" >/dev/null
python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 192.0.2.1 >/tmp/fwprobe-8080.log 2>&1 & p8080=$!
python3 -m http.server 8081 --bind 192.0.2.1 >/tmp/fwprobe-8081.log 2>&1 & p8081=$!
sleep 1
kill -0 "$p8080"
kill -0 "$p8081"
printf 'post_restart_boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '%s\n' '--- temporary listeners for post-restart packet probes ---'
ss -lntp | awk '$4 ~ /:8080$/ || $4 ~ /:8081$/ {print}'
if ip netns exec "$ns" timeout 3 bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/192.0.2.1/22'; then printf '%s\n' 'post_restart_probe_ssh=ACCEPTED'; else exit 1; fi
if ip netns exec "$ns" timeout 3 bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/192.0.2.1/8080'; then printf '%s\n' 'post_restart_probe_tcp_8080=ACCEPTED'; else exit 1; fi
if ip netns exec "$ns" timeout 3 bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/192.0.2.1/8081' 2>/tmp/fwprobe-reject.err; then printf '%s\n' 'post_restart_probe_tcp_8081=UNEXPECTEDLY_ACCEPTED'; exit 1; else printf '%s\n' 'post_restart_probe_tcp_8081=REJECTED'; sed -n '1,3p' /tmp/fwprobe-reject.err; fi
printf '%s\n' 'post_restart_inbound_probe_assertions=PASS'
commands.stdout:
post_restart_boot_id=dad43f48-6d20-44aa-9849-c841515ee339
--- temporary listeners for post-restart packet probes ---
LISTEN 0      5          192.0.2.1:8081      0.0.0.0:*    users:(("python3",pid=943,fd=6))
LISTEN 0      5          192.0.2.1:8080      0.0.0.0:*    users:(("python3",pid=942,fd=6))
post_restart_probe_ssh=ACCEPTED
post_restart_probe_tcp_8080=ACCEPTED
post_restart_probe_tcp_8081=REJECTED
bash: connect: No route to host
bash: line 1: /dev/tcp/192.0.2.1/8081: No route to host
post_restart_inbound_probe_assertions=PASS

commands.command:
set -eu
if ip netns list | grep -q '^antrieb-fwprobe'; then printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: probe namespace remains'; exit 1; fi
if ip link show fwprobe-host >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: probe link remains'; exit 1; fi
printf '%s\n' 'post_restart_probe_cleanup=PASS'
printf 'final_boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'firewalld_enabled='; systemctl is-enabled firewalld
printf 'firewalld_active='; systemctl is-active firewalld
printf 'sshd_enabled='; systemctl is-enabled sshd
printf 'sshd_active='; systemctl is-active sshd
firewall-cmd --zone=public --query-service=ssh >/dev/null
firewall-cmd --zone=public --query-port=8080/tcp >/dev/null
if firewall-cmd --zone=public --query-service=cockpit >/dev/null; then exit 1; fi
if firewall-cmd --zone=public --query-service=dhcpv6-client >/dev/null; then exit 1; fi
printf 'final_target='; firewall-cmd --permanent --zone=public --get-target
printf 'final_runtime_services='; firewall-cmd --zone=public --list-services
printf 'final_runtime_ports='; firewall-cmd --zone=public --list-ports
printf 'final_permanent_services='; firewall-cmd --permanent --zone=public --list-services
printf 'final_permanent_ports='; firewall-cmd --permanent --zone=public --list-ports
printf '%s\n' 'final_state=HEALTHY'
commands.stdout:
post_restart_probe_cleanup=PASS
final_boot_id=dad43f48-6d20-44aa-9849-c841515ee339
firewalld_enabled=enabled
firewalld_active=active
sshd_enabled=enabled
sshd_active=active
final_target=REJECT
final_runtime_services=ssh
final_runtime_ports=8080/tcp
final_permanent_services=ssh
final_permanent_ports=8080/tcp
final_state=HEALTHY
